revenue.heading: Revenue Trends Analysis
revenue.explanation:
This chart shows the revenue trends across different hotel types over the entire period.

Total revenue: €25,996,260.41
Average monthly revenue: €499,928.08
Highest revenue (€1,084,751.27) was recorded in August 2017

City Hotel hotels generated the highest total revenue (€14,394,410.18)

Revenue distribution: City Hotel: 55.4%, Resort Hotel: 44.6%

The overall revenue trend is increasing over the years.

cancellation.heading: Cancellation Rates Analysis
cancellation.explanation:
This chart shows the cancellation rates across different hotel types over the entire period.

Total bookings: 119,390
Total cancellations: 44,224
Overall cancellation rate: 37.04%

Highest cancellation rate: 67.17% (July 2015, City Hotel)
Lowest cancellation rate: 13.46% (January 2016, Resort Hotel)

City Hotel hotels:
  - Cancellation rate: 41.73%
  - Total bookings: 79,330

Resort Hotel hotels:
  - Cancellation rate: 27.76%
  - Total bookings: 40,060

City Hotel hotels have a 13.96% higher cancellation rate than Resort Hotel hotels.

The overall cancellation rate trend is increasing over the years.

geographical.heading: Geographical Distribution Analysis
geographical.explanation:
This chart shows the geographical distribution of bookings across different hotel types over the entire period.

Total bookings: 119,390
Number of countries: 178

Top 5 countries by number of bookings:
  - PRT: 48,590 bookings (40.7% of total)
  - GBR: 12,129 bookings (10.2% of total)
  - FRA: 10,415 bookings (8.7% of total)
  - ESP: 8,568 bookings (7.2% of total)
  - DEU: 7,287 bookings (6.1% of total)

The top 5 countries account for 72.9% of all bookings.

In PRT (the top country), City Hotel is the most popular hotel type with 30,960 bookings (63.7% of bookings from this country).

Domestic bookings (from Portugal) account for 40.7% of all bookings, while international bookings account for 59.3%.

booking_lead.heading: Booking Lead Time Analysis
booking_lead.explanation:
This chart shows the lead time distribution across different hotel types over the entire period.

Booking lead time statistics:
  - Average lead time: 104.0 days
  - Median lead time: 69 days
  - Minimum lead time: 0 days
  - Maximum lead time: 737 days

Lead time distribution:
  - 0-7 days: 11.9%
  - 8-30 days: 16.8%
  - 31-90 days: 26.1%
  - 91-180 days: 23.4%
  - 181-365 days: 19.1%
  - 365+ days: 2.8%

The most common booking window is 31-90 days (26.1% of bookings).

Lead time comparison by hotel type:
  - Resort Hotel:
    - Average lead time: 92.7 days
    - Median lead time: 57 days
  - City Hotel:
    - Average lead time: 109.7 days
    - Median lead time: 74 days

City Hotel bookings have on average 17.1 days longer lead time than Resort Hotel bookings.

Relationship between lead time and cancellation:
  - Average lead time for canceled bookings: 144.8 days
  - Average lead time for non-canceled bookings: 80.0 days

Bookings with longer lead times are more likely to be canceled.

City Hotel:
